allow_tcp_forwarding.description: Allow TCP port forwarding: yes, no, local, or remote. Use no for a pure SFTP server.

authorized_keys_file.description: Location of authorized_keys file(s); %h expands to user home, %u to username.

challenge_response_authentication.description: Allow keyboard-interactive (PAM challenge-response) authentication: yes or no.

host_keys.description: Absolute paths to host private key files, one per algorithm.

value.description: Absolute path to a host private key file.

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses to bind to. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.

value.description: An IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to listen on.

log_level.description: Log verbosity: QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, DEBUG1, DEBUG2, DEBUG3.

login_grace_time.description: Seconds an unauthenticated connection is kept open before being dropped (e.g. 30, 2m).

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum authentication attempts per connection before the connection is closed.

max_sessions.description: Maximum concurrent sessions multiplexed over a single network connection.

password_authentication.description: Allow password authentication. Recommended: no for key-only SFTP deployments.

permit_empty_passwords.description: Allow accounts with empty passwords to authenticate: yes or no.

permit_root_login.description: Allow root to log in: yes, no, prohibit-password, or forced-commands-only.

print_motd.description: Print /etc/motd after a successful interactive login: yes or no.

pubkey_authentication.description: Allow public-key authentication: yes or no.

sftp_groups.description: Unix groups that receive SFTP-only access inside a chroot jail. Evaluated as sshd Match Group blocks.

chroot_dir.description: Absolute path of the chroot root. Must be owned root:root with mode 0755.

sftp_log_level.description: Optional internal-sftp -l log level (e.g. VERBOSE, DEBUG). Leave empty for the server default.

sftp_subsystem.description: SFTP subsystem handler. Use internal-sftp (built-in, supports chroot) or an absolute path to a standalone sftp-server binary.

sftp_users.description: Individual users that receive SFTP-only access inside a chroot jail. Evaluated as sshd Match User blocks after sftp_groups.

chroot_dir.description: Absolute path of the chroot root. Must be owned root:root with mode 0755.

sftp_log_level.description: Optional internal-sftp -l log level (e.g. VERBOSE, DEBUG). Leave empty for the server default.

ssh_port.description: TCP port the SFTP server listens on.

strict_modes.description: Enforce ownership and permission checks on key files and home directories: yes or no.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for SSH daemon messages: AUTH, DAEMON, LOCAL0 through LOCAL7.

use_pam.description: Enable PAM for account and session management: yes or no.

x11_forwarding.description: Allow X11 display forwarding: yes or no.
